name: job_queue
description: Durable FIFO + priority queue for AIOS jobs (one unit of execution submitted to the runtime). Jobs survive process restarts (persisted via memory module). A job carries a CapabilityDemand, a target engine, and a trace id.

inputs.name: job
inputs.description: Job record { job_id: AIOS-JOB-NNNNNN, demand: AIOS-CONTRACT-000010 demand, engine_id, priority, trace_id }

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: One of: enqueue, dequeue, peek, cancel, status.

outputs.name: queue_state
outputs.description: Snapshot { depth, head_job_id, head_priority, paused: bool }

side_effects: Persists enqueue/dequeue events to memory module
Emits AIOS-EVENT-000010 job_enqueued and AIOS-EVENT-000011 job_dequeued

error_codes.recovery: Reject enqueue and advise operator to drain or raise max depth in config.

error_codes.message: No job with the given job_id.
error_codes.recovery: Return NotFound status; do not retry blindly.
Reject and surface the existing job's status.
